requirements.statement: After a create-trd run, every grounding block that reached disk is in the TRD's '## 9. Task Grounding' section, put there by deterministic code, not by an agent pasting blocks into the TRD.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O1 (#49 Expected; owner instruction 2026-10-30); must pass: yes

requirements.statement: The readout's grounded count and its list of ungrounded tasks come from parsing the TRD on disk immediately before the readout, never from agents' return values.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O2 (#49 Expected); must pass: yes

requirements.statement: A task no grounding agent returned a block for gets one targeted re-ground; a task still missing after that is named as ungrounded in the readout and the run completes, not stuck, even when every grounding agent died.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O3; must pass: no

requirements.statement: The '## Deferred by design' table is written by the same deterministic code, and a missing deferred list is reported as missing, never read as 'nothing deferred'.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O4 (owner instruction; adversarial review); must pass: no

requirements.statement: The merge agent only reports contradictions between blocks; it writes nothing.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O5; must pass: no

tasks.description: New deterministic helper packages/core/lib/trd-grounding.js (+ .test.js) with assemble and report CLI modes, writing the Task Grounding and Deferred sections from block files and sizing.json; deliver via packages/full/lib symlink, .claude/lib copy, and scaffold-delivery test module list. Dependencies: none.

Change packages/core/workflows/create-trd.js (+ test): grounding_dir argument, per-agent block files, sizing.json written by sizing agent, single ground:retry for missing ids, read-only merge agent, defer:write removed, grounded_tasks renamed grounded_claimed and dropped from readout; mirror to .claude/workflows/. Dependencies: FIX-001.

Update packages/core/commands/create-trd.md (workflow and fallback paths) and packages/core/commands/plan.md (medium path): pass grounding_dir, run trd-grounding.js assemble after Workflow(create-trd) and report before the readout; rewrite merge-assembles wording; mirror to .claude/commands/. Dependencies: FIX-001, FIX-002.

could_not_verify: A live /create-trd run on a TRD large enough to fan out has not been done. The reproduction uses the workflow harness with stubbed agents, which proves the wiring but not that real agents follow the 'write your own file' instruction. An agent that returns blocks but writes no file is caught by the helper's ungrounded list (O3), not prevented.

Forge, or any other caller of Workflow(create-trd) outside this repo, has not been checked. Making grounding_dir optional with a default is what keeps such a caller working. Its stale-run risk is logged, not prevented.
open_questions: OQ-1 (owner-only): Should ungrounded tasks also be recorded in the TRD itself (e.g. a line in '## Could Not Verify'), not only in the readout? Assumed: readout only; trd-parser.js:845-851 already warns about each ungrounded task when /implement-trd parses the TRD.
